title: Storybound NPC binding
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/npc_bindings/<path>.json — which entities start which dialogue, and how. The first file by id whose selector matches applies; /storybound npc bind on an entity wins over files.

dialogues.description: Tried by priority, highest first; the first whose conditions pass is started. None passing: the click does what it normally does (trading).

proximity.description: Coming close starts the dialogue; again only after leaving and coming back.

cooldown.description: Seconds before the same NPC may start it again for the player.

once.description: At most once per player, ever.

custom.description: Right-click posts the KubeJS npcInteract event; the script decides.

override_interact.description: Right-click starts the dialogue and cancels the entity's vanilla interaction (e.g. villager trade menu).

exclusive.description: While the NPC talks with one player, others cannot start its dialogues (they get busy_dialogue, or nothing). Off: several players talk with it at once.

busy_dialogue.description: What others get while an exclusive NPC talks: e.g. a bubble "Wait, I am busy".

respawn.description: When the NPC dies or disappears, the same NPC (its name, look, trades and uuid) comes back where it was 5 seconds later. It drops nothing when it dies.
